comparison.objective: Clip a wafer to an evaporator plate and load it face-down into a load lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Center a fragile wafer, swing and tighten multiple clips, invert/load an assembly, and operate a timed door lock.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer securely clipped, plate correctly loaded face-down, door shut and locked, hands clear; contact, over-tightening, or timing violations fail.
comparison.reason: Fragile fixture loading and clip tightening do not test screen-driven particle separation. No material rubric detail is missing.
